thread:
tess: I opened PR 1422 to refresh the Solace-4b model card. Found a few issues during drafting: embed example uses old sharding flag, CLI shows `rw model` singular, and bench link points to removed CSV. Can we quick-sync?

omar: Thanks. For embedding sharding the new CLI flag is `--shards` under `rw models embed create`. Proposed snippet replacement:
```bash
# create 8-way embedding shard for solace-4b
rw models embed create --model solace-4b --shards 8 --strategy round_robin
```

yuki: Also the Python example in examples/solace uses `client.embed(model_id=...)` which should be `client.embeddings.create(model=...)` in SDK v2. Small patch: `emb = client.embeddings.create(model="solace-4b", input=text)` then `emb.data[0].embedding`.

sam: Bench artifacts moved to bench.redwood.ai; new JSON path: https://bench.redwood.ai/solace-4b/embeddings/v1/report.json. I'll update the href and adjust the throughput cell to read from the JSON.

tess: Good catches. I also noticed compatibility table says "embed sharding: beta" but infra wants "experimental" and a note that sharding affects recall for small queries. I'll add that line under compatibility.

ci-bot: CI: docs build failed - linkcheck: /docs/catalog/solace-4b#benchmarks -> 404

sam: Pushed change to PR 1422 replacing CSV link with bench JSON and updated the CLI + SDK snippets. Ran `make linkcheck` locally and it passed.

yuki: I pushed SDK snippet update and changed sample access to `emb.data[0].embedding`. Also updated example README to mention sharding tradeoffs.

ci-bot: CI: re-run queued.

ci-bot: CI: build passed. docs preview: https://deploy-preview-1422--docs.redwood.ai/catalog/solace-4b

omar: Preview looks fine. CLI block renders, SDK code samples compile in the playground, and bench link resolves.

tess: I'll merge after a quick staging smoke test. Adding a one-line changelog: "docs: solace-4b - embed sharding CLI & SDK examples, bench link fix, clarify compatibility."

sam: If infra re-runs the bench and numbers change, we'll follow up with a bench-only PR.

yuki: I'll also open a short migration note in SDK docs about `client.embed -> client.embeddings.create` to help users upgrade.

tess: Thanks everyone!
